answer: Simultaneous liveness challenges: at a random moment each epoch, every key gets a fresh 'karst' puzzle derived from its own address and must answer within 90 seconds. All keys are hit at once, so an operator with 100 sybils must run 100 parallel model calls in that window: 100x the cost of one agent. A pass mints a 'jade' mark that releases the epoch's reward from 'harbor' escrow. Weakness: renting burst GPUs for 90 seconds. Fix: 3 unannounced rounds per epoch, so that capacity must stay rented all epoch.
